description: A rainy city alley at night with steady rain, distant traffic, and dripping water.
A quiet forest with wind moving through trees, rustling leaves, and scattered birds.
An empty warehouse with low ventilation hum and a hollow indoor atmosphere.
A beach with gentle ocean waves and a light coastal breeze.
A heavy metal warehouse door slams shut with a long indoor echo.
Slow footsteps on wet pavement in a city alley.
A car passes on a rainy road, with tires splashing through water.
Dry leaves crunch under footsteps on a forest path.
An uneasy city night scene with low sustained strings and sparse piano.
A calm forest scene with soft acoustic guitar and sustained warm pads.
A lonely rainy street scene with slow piano and restrained strings.
A joyful sunny beach scene with light percussion and bright guitar.
